headline: Shivam Autotech, Shraddha Prime, and Anand Rathi set record dates
hook: Final day to capture upcoming corporate actions
summary: Shivam Autotech and Shraddha Prime Projects have fixed October 15, 2026, as the record date for their respective rights issues. Anand Rathi Wealth has also set the same date for its ₹4 per share interim dividend. This follows Anand Rathi Wealth's report of a 22% profit growth for the September quarter. Investors must purchase shares by today to be eligible for these corporate actions.
whats_next: October 15, 2026: Record date for all three companies
why_it_matters: Buy today to qualify for dividends or rights issue participation.
winners_losers: Shareholders gain / Late buyers miss out
